policy: Minimal, case-targeted anonymization (METHODOLOGY.md §6). The REAL HDFS source and the REAL reproduction log are used, with system identifiers KEPT (DatanodeDescriptor, HeartbeatManager, FSNamesystem, datanode, namenode, block, ...). Only two things are redacted: the JIRA bug id, and the one distinctive metric term that names the bug.
regenerate: source/ and logs/symptom.log are gitignored and rebuilt deterministically by private/anonymize.sh (inputs: repos/HDFS-HDFS-11896 @ pre_fix_commit for source; private/symptom.orig.log from reproduce.sh for the log).

bug_id.note: The bug id only appeared in the reproduction log via the scratch-clone path /work/repos/HDFS-HDFS-11896/...; scrubbed. It does not occur in the source.

distinctive_term_rename.why: The JIRA title is 'Non-dfsUsed will be doubled on dead node re-registration'; renaming the nonDfsUsed metric removes the string a reader would grep to recall the exact ticket, while keeping the code otherwise real.

kept_as_is: All other HDFS identifiers: class names (DatanodeDescriptor, HeartbeatManager, DatanodeManager, BlockManager, FSNamesystem, StorageReport, DatanodeInfo, DatanodeStorageInfo), method names (resetBlocks, register, addDatanode, updateHeartbeatState, registerDatanode, removeDeadDatanode), dfsUsed, blockPoolUsed, and all runtime log lines (registerDatanode / removeDeadDatanode / etc.).
